hook_line: AIR INDIA AND INDIGO CUT EUROPE FLIGHTS

stats.label: India-Europe two-way winter seats, down from 6.02 million
End of the only nonstop link between Austria and India
Birmingham-India two-way passengers, down 8.3 per cent

diaspora_bullets: Expect fewer nonstops and higher loads on remaining India-Europe flights
Withdrawn nonstops push passengers onto one-stop itineraries via Gulf and European hubs
news_summary: Air India is cutting four European routes in the winter schedule and IndiGo has suspended Manchester and will pause Heathrow, as India-Europe winter seats fall to 5.63 million, down 6.5% from 6.02 million a year earlier.
payoff: Foreign carriers are picking up the passengers Air India and IndiGo leave behind.
